description: Paying for complexity (layers, services, deploy units) before the problem it solves exists.
Separately deployed parts that must still change and release together. Distribution costs without independence.
A generic solution built before enough concrete cases exist. Often harder to change than duplication.
Choosing technology for its appeal to the people choosing it, not for the product's ranked quality attributes.
Named problem, ranked attribute, written cost, reversibility and smallest step: checks before adding architecture.
